comparison.objective: Candidate removes a terminal; record joins two drive-chain ends with a connecting link and retaining plate.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate combines wire deflection, thin-blade tab release, and coordinated withdrawal; record aligns multiple chain holes and stems, inserts a link, and slides a keeper plate into retention while maintaining chain guidance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective undamaged extraction; record requires both chain ends seated, keeper engaged, joint in its cradle, all links guided, and hands released.
comparison.reason: Multi-part chain alignment and retained assembly are meaningfully different from connector disassembly.
